data.description: If a trompe l'oeil is depicted wearing armor or a shield, these items are masterwork and gain an enhancement bonus (or equivalent armor special abilities) when worn by the trompe l'oeil, as indicated in the table. If the trompe l'oeil is depicted without armor, add the armor enhancement bonus to its natural armor bonus instead. Armor and shields equipped by a trompe l'oeil melt into puddles of nonmagical paint when the creature is destroyed.
